name: Biei no Oka de
overview:
Biei Town, spread out at the foothills of the Tokachidake mountain range in Hokkaido. There, Kaoru and Riko, who have come from Tokyo, work hard in training as they aim to start new lives as farmers.

However, the integration of agriculture and tourism presents various challenges, and the two repeatedly struggle, worry, and grow through each obstacle they face.
